title: ‘We Were in Over Our Heads’: Inside the Wild Debut of America’s New Pro Cycling Team
content:
Modern Adventure Pro Cycling won five races in its inaugural season. Bobby Julich explains how the team's bet on overlooked riders paid off and what's next for 2027.

Read the full article at ‘We Were in Over Our Heads’: Inside the Wild Debut of America’s New Pro Cycling Team on Velo.
author: ahood
